digest.component_or_area: gate dispatch and sidecar infrastructure-exception handling
propositions: When a gate encounters an infrastructure exception (LLMUnavailableError), an ERROR sidecar record with schema gate_error_v1 must be written additively before the existing per-gate outcome is applied (degrade for plan/code-review, propagate for completion).

The gate_error_v1 schema payload includes verdict='ERROR', gate name, and error object with cause and evidence_ref fields, ensuring ERROR verdicts survive without being coerced to FAIL by reconcile_verdict.

Existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must remain unaffected by gate_error_v1 records due to schema-based filtering, preventing ERROR verdicts from polluting verdict reads or being unexpectedly surfaced.
Domain-level failures (BLOCK/FAIL from non-infrastructure causes) must not emit gate_error_v1 records, reserving ERROR capture solely for infrastructure exceptions.

The completion path must emit the ERROR record then re-raise the exception to preserve fail-closed behavior, while plan-review and code-review paths emit ERROR then return existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts to preserve soft-degrade behavior.
